title: THE EARLY PROCEDURE
text: A classification procedure in Jack's desk predates this implementation. The method is older than the software that currently executes it. This is an index disturbance, not proof of prior employment.

title: OLD JACK
text: A damaged record dated 17 April 2033 addresses the clerk as Old Jack. The speaker appears to be Mabel. The record is incomplete. It is not accepted as canon.

title: KEEP HIM TALKING
text:
MABEL: Jack, keep him talking.
JACK: Until when?
MABEL: Until he reaches us.
The referent of him is not established. This exchange is locked until an authorised narrative condition is met.

title: THE RETURNED DOSSIER
text: A future index mark may describe a dossier as returned before it has been lodged. If such a mark appears, hold it as unclassified. Do not invent the missing lodging.
